subsection.name: Introduction
subsection.p: This module adds Google Maps to the map providers of a geolocation entry (plugin-forms, plugin-appointment): the entry renders a map, a marker the user moves and an address search.

subsection.name: Configuration
subsection.p: The Google Maps JavaScript API needs a key. Set it in genericattributes-googlemaps.apiKey (WEB-INF/conf/plugins/form-googlemaps.properties, an override file, or the environment variable GENERICATTRIBUTES_GOOGLEMAPS_APIKEY).

The Content-Security-Policy of Lutece 8 allows scripts from the site only. Add a security header configuration item for the pages that show the entry (for the forms front office, the url pattern /jsp/site/Portal.jsp**) with the shipped policy completed with https://maps.googleapis.com https://maps.gstatic.com in script-src, img-src and connect-src, and https://fonts.googleapis.com in style-src.
Lutece 8 also sends Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp, which blocks the map images Google serves: the same pages need a configuration item of that header with the value credentialless.
